Name: WSilenceW's Garden Fences and Gates(AT)
Author: WSilenceW
Description:
为硬木围栏和大门增加5种园艺风纹理，有季节变化，使用AT为前置。
下载AT前置和本mod后，在罗宾商店购买油漆桶或喷枪道具，改变硬木围栏和大门纹理。

我的小红书账号：韭菜炖大鹅 

=======================================================================

Adds 5 garden style textures for the Hardwood Fence and Gate, with seasonal changes. Requires Alternative Textures.

After installing Alternative Textures and this mod, buy a Paint Bucket or Spray Gun from Robin's shop to change the textures of the Hardwood Fence and Gate.
